audit_items.proof_trace: The validation correctly enforces len(commits) <= MaxBlobsPerBlock(slot) using epoch-dependent limits from BlobSchedule. While MaxBlobsPerBlock performs in-place sorting of BlobSchedule (lines 704-710 in config.go), production builds lack locking around BeaconConfig() access, creating a potential data race. However, this race would only cause incorrect sorting order temporarily, not bypass the length check itself, as the validation reads the current limit value atomically. The property holds: blob counts cannot exceed the epoch limit.
